Package com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms

Class AbstractJmsReceiver

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.AbstractReceiver
      • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.AbstractJmsReceiver
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SenderRecoveryListener
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    JmsReceiver, JmsReceiver
    public abstract class AbstractJmsReceiver
extends AbstractReceiver
    The part of the JMS receiver that does not touch a JMS type, shared by the javax.jms and the jakarta.jms receiver.

    Internal SDK infrastructure, not an extension point: it is public only so that the receiver implementations in other packages can extend it. Messages are passed as Object so that no JMS namespace is named here; the abstract hooks are where a subclass supplies them.

      • init

        public void init​(ClientSettings settings)
        Initializes this Receiver via the given settings.

        Valid settings are:

        • "njams.sdk.communication.jms.connectionFactory"
        • "njams.sdk.communication.jms.username"
        • "njams.sdk.communication.jms.password"
        • "njams.sdk.communication.jms.destination" (or its alternative "njams.sdk.communication.jms.destination.prefix")
        • ...
        For more look in the github FAQ of this project.
        Overrides:
        init in class AbstractReceiver
        Parameters:
        settings - the settings needed to init
        Throws:
        TransportNotApplicableException - if the configured JMS factory belongs to the other JMS namespace

      • resolveFactory

        protected abstract void resolveFactory​(ClientSettings settings)
        Resolves the JMS factory this receiver will use. Called first during init(ClientSettings). Implementations signal that the configured factory belongs to the other JMS namespace by throwing a TransportNotApplicableException.

        Implementations must read from the settings parameter: the inherited settings field is only assigned after this hook has returned.

        Parameters:
        settings - the settings the receiver is initialized with

        protected com.faizsiegeln.njams.messageformat.v4.command.Instruction getInstruction​(Object message)
